function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "cd "$(pwd)"; mkdir -p out
# Sum all integers in a.txt
awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ /^[+-]?[0-9]+$/) s+=$i} END{print s+0}' data/a.txt > out/sum.txt
cat out/sum.txt
# Dedup + case-sensitive dictionary sort of words in b.txt
LC_ALL=C tr -s '[:space:]' '\n' < data/b.txt | LC_ALL=C grep -v '^$' | LC_ALL=C sort -u > out/words.txt
cat -A out/words.txt; echo "word count: $(wc -l < out/words.txt)""}
